# Environment Variables

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_env_reference.py from launcher/flags_catalog.h.
     Edit the catalog, then rerun the script. -->

`m2host`, the guest runtime, and the launcher read the `M2_*` and `IMSA_*`
environment variables below. Most are developer diagnostics: each stays off
unless set, and tracing output is bounded by a per-stream cap. The launcher
sets several of the user-facing settings (game data, saves, fixes, presentation)
from its tabs.

Conventions used below:

- A boolean switch is on when set to a nonempty value other than `0`, unless
  its description specifies `=1` or "When set to 1".
- "Default-on" entries are already active; set them to `0` to compare against
  the alternative each description names.
- `_FROM` variables set a starting frame or list sequence number, and `_MAX` or
  `_N` variables raise a trace's line cap. Values accept decimal or `0x` hex.
- Host frames count presented frames; guest frames count the game's own frame
  loop; list sequence numbers count executed command lists.

See [Diagnostics](../../AGENTS.md#diagnostics) for the trace file, control socket, and
recording tools these switches complement.

## Controls

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `M2_IMPROVED_ANALOG_STEERING` | Opt-in live tire-force-based analog steering; =1 enables it in Original, Patched, and Custom profiles across Arcade and Simulation. Calculates turning-force maxima from live tire contacts while retaining low-speed parking lock and native D-pad response. Default off; disabled during replay, input recording, and diagnostic control. |

## Game data, boot & saves

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `IMSA_DATA_DIR` | Extracted game-data folder (the one containing driving/game); used when --game-data and --root are not given. |
| `M2_BOOT_APP` | Boot one guest image directly instead of running the disc's LaunchMe.m2 shell: game (or driving) for racing, shooter2d for the companion game. Unset runs the disc's own launcher and its game-to-shooter2d handoff. |
| `M2_GUEST_ARGS` | Stage guest boot argv (e.g. "-V"); authentic launch argv is empty. |
| `M2_MICROCARD_ROOT` | MicroCard save folder used by m2host and the launcher, overriding the platform default. |
| `M2_SAVESTATE_DIR` | m2host: directory for --savestate-save/--savestate-load defaults. |
| `M2_SCREENSHOT_ROOT` | Writable destination for the original developer screenshot.N framebuffer dumps and matching .ppm previews; defaults to the screenshots sibling of the default card folder. |

## Game fixes & restored features

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `M2_HUD_TACH_FIX` | Default-on fix for the exterior-camera tachometer range. DrawInfoBar (0x1608c) passes a fixed 0.015 gauge scale (180 units over 12,000 RPM), which matches the Ferrari V12's 11,500 RPM redline but leaves the 8,500 RPM Oldsmobile, Ford, and Mazda engines at 127.5 of 180. Unset or nonzero rescales the exterior gauge from the player engine's redline (plyrEng+0x00); =0 keeps the original fixed scale. |
| `M2_LAGUNA_PHANTOM_FIX` | Default-on fix for the Laguna Seca phantom crash. With no phantom on the MicroCard, repRestorePhantom (0x27250) reads the disc's ra_&lt;track&gt;_phantom.dat into a 0x11978-byte buffer; Laguna's file is 1,354,716 bytes (a 3,288-frame phantom followed by an unused pose/control recording), overrunning the heap. Unset or nonzero bounds the read to the buffer size; =0 preserves the original overrun. |
| `M2_MENU_PREVIEW_CLIP_FIX` | Default-on fix for the menu car preview clip: UI_ShowMerc reuses the CloseData width left behind by the race rear-view pass, so the host restores UI_MercInit's width for that UI draw. =0 keeps the original behavior. |
| `M2_PLAYER_CAR_VARIANT` | Opt-in player-car body variant; =1 or =2 selects the second or third authored body variant in MS_buildcar/MS_rebuildcar when present in the car pack (the Skid Pad special pack only includes variant 0). Unset or 0 keeps the default first variant. |
| `M2_RESTORE_BEST_TIMES` | Opt-in restoration of the unused post-race summary screen (UI_DrawBestTimes); =1 shows race time, best lap, average speed, and finishing place after the result movie and before the high-score table. |
| `M2_RESTORE_CREDITS` | Opt-in restoration of the unfinished scrolling credits screen; =1 routes the main-menu Credits option to the interactive credits routine instead of playing credits.mov. |
| `M2_RESTORE_DRAFTING` | Opt-in restoration of the unused drafting effect (HandleDrafting); =1 reduces the player's aerodynamic drag and lift by up to 25% when within 60 ft behind and 6 ft laterally of a leading car. |
| `M2_SKIDPAD_ENGINE_FIX` | Opt-in skidpad engine-sound rebind; =1 rebinds the two engine-sound channels when the player swaps engines in-session on the Skid Pad instead of keeping the entry-time sample pair. |
| `M2_UNLOCK_SECRET_TRACK` | Opt-in secret-track unlock (activatesecrettrack); =1 unlocks the sixth track entry (Psychedelia / leary) in Choose Track without first triggering the Skid Pad unlock zone. |

## Presentation

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `M2_ANISOTROPY` | Anisotropic filtering level (1-16, clamped to the device maximum) for primary decoded CLT textures. Values above 1 also enable linear mipmapped sampling, while SSB masks and framebuffer-feedback sources keep their guest sampling. Unset or 1 uses guest filter state. |
| `M2_ANTIALIASING` | MSAA sample count (2-8, clamped to GL_MAX_SAMPLES) for the GL backends' CLT color targets. Unset or 1 keeps single-sample targets. GL backends only. |
| `M2_AUDIO_MUTE` | Silence the SDL audio output stream with zero gain while keeping the asynchronous DSPP worker running at normal cadence. |
| `M2_BITMAP_FILTER` | Sampling filter for direct Projector bitmap scanouts (menus, stills, FMV) when scaled to the window: linear or sharp (sharp bilinear). Unset or nearest keeps nearest-neighbor sampling. GL backends only. |
| `M2_CROP_OVERSCAN` | Default-on overscan crop (launcher Graphics tab). Crops the 640x480 display buffer to the active 576x432 viewport at (32, 24) for both Triangle Engine targets and bitmap/FMV scanouts. =0 displays the full 640x480 buffer with its outer border. |
| `M2_DISPLAY_INDEX` | 0-based SDL display index for placing the host window on multi-monitor setups; unset uses the platform default display. |
| `M2_GL_SWAP_INTERVAL` | OpenGL swap interval (default 1); =0 disables blocking vsync swap waits while keeping VBL frame pacing unless --fast-forward is active. |
| `M2_HIRES_EFFECTS` | When set to 1, keeps GPU framebuffer-feedback (DB-source) snapshots at the scaled render resolution instead of downsampling to 640x480, so rear-view mirrors, previews, and screen transitions match the internal render scale. |
| `M2_DISABLE_CAR_LOD` | When set to 1, pins MS_ScanList's car LOD band to 0 so MS_addgroup draws the highest-detail car mesh at all distances instead of switching at 150/300, 50/100, or 100/200 units. |
| `M2_RENDER_SCALE` | Internal render resolution multiplier for GL backends (launcher Graphics tab). Unset or 0 matches the window drawable; 1-8 renders at N x 640x480 (clamped to the GPU limit) and downsamples to the window. |
| `M2_RGB555_DITHER` | When set to 1, applies the guest's 4x4 ordered dither matrix (DITHEREN + DBDITHERMATRIX) and 5-bit RGB555 quantization in the fragment shader. |
| `M2_TEXTURE_FILTER` | Texture sampling filter for primary decoded CLT textures (launcher Graphics tab): linear for bilinear, or sharp for sharp bilinear. Unset uses the guest's per-draw filter state. |
| `M2_TEXTURE_REPLACEMENTS` | Path to a manifest mapping original texture dimensions and packed-RGBA FNV64 hashes to replacement PNG files. |
| `M2_VBL_PACED_SWAP` | Default-on VBL deadline pacing: presents with SDL swap interval 0 and paces the loop on the 59.94 Hz NTSC VBL timer so a late display swap does not stretch guest fields. =0 uses blocking vsync swap pacing. |

## Runtime & kernel diagnostics

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `M2_DEVICE_CMD_TRACE` | Log refused device command words and accepted command argument-form decisions ([device-form], capped at 256 lines per level unless raised by M2_DEVICE_CMD_TRACE_MAX). |
| `M2_DEVICE_CMD_TRACE_MAX` | Line cap for each M2_DEVICE_CMD_TRACE stream (default 256, max 4096). |
| `M2_FONT_DIAG` | Log Font Folio text-state construction (glyph ranges, first character count and texel) and any CreateTextState error to stderr. |
| `M2_FRAME_TIMING` | Log per-frame host wait/pump/present/audio timings, CLT list execution breakdowns, audio-pump phase splits ([audio-timing]), and an on-exit [frame-timing-summary] (p50/p95/p99, over-budget count, guest fps). Value sets an optional starting guest frame floor (e.g. 650 to skip boot). |
| `M2_INVALID_ACCESS_TRACE` | Log bounded invalid guest memory accesses with PC and EA. |
| `M2_KERNEL_LOCK_DIAG` | Print a [kernel-lock] summary at exit with lock acquisition counts, total wait time, top holder call sites, and top waiter sites. |
| `M2_KERNEL_NOTE_LIBRARY_ALL` | When set to 1, emits kernel-boundary notes for the four C-library helpers (memmove, memset, __itof, __utof) routed through the selector table. |
| `M2_MPEG_TRACE` | Trace FMV playback: mpegvideo WRITE/READ commands, raw movie reads, DataStream/DataAcq subscriber waits, and VideoPlayer folio calls. |
| `M2_NATIVE_CRASH_TRACE` | macOS: print a native backtrace on SIGBUS, SIGSEGV, or SIGILL, then exit. |
| `M2_OOB_COUNT` | Print the total out-of-bounds memory trap count ([guest] oob_traps) at m2host exit. |
| `M2_PERF` | Enable the host phase-profiler without --perf-file (records guest/CLT phase timings; default off). |
| `M2_POWF_TRACE` | Log base/exponent inputs and return values for the first 16 guest powf domain/range errors. |
| `M2_SIGNAL_TRACE` | Log up to 256 kernel SendSignal and WaitSignal calls with task IDs and signal masks. |
| `M2_SIMWAIT_DIAG` | Log the first 64 CarSimThread WaitIO calls with their device and pre-wait state. |
| `M2_TRACE` | m2host: enable the NDJSON discovery trace (same as --trace-file with default path). |

## Provenance engine

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `M2_PROVENANCE` | EA-scoped memory watch, "EA-EA,EA-EA" ranges; logs bounded write/read history to M2_PROVENANCE_OUT. |
| `M2_PROVENANCE_ALLOCS` | Provenance engine: also trace allocation events. |
| `M2_PROVENANCE_COPIES` | Provenance engine: also trace bulk-copy events (memcpy-class). |
| `M2_PROVENANCE_OUT` | Provenance engine: JSON output path (default stdout summary). |
| `M2_PROVENANCE_READS` | Provenance engine: trace reads in addition to writes. |
| `M2_PROVENANCE_WRITES` | Provenance engine: trace writes (default on when M2_PROVENANCE is set). |
| `M2_PROV_FREAD_TRACE` | Provenance engine: trace fread record loads (bounded). |

## Audio diagnostics

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `M2_AUDIO_BUFFER_DIAG` | Log once-per-second DSP FIFO queue health (generated, consumed, queued, and missing frames). |
| `M2_AUDIO_CALCRATE_DIAG` | Log effective AF_TAG_CALCRATE_DIVIDE divider/priority per CreateInstrument ([audio-calcrate], cap 32). |
| `M2_AUDIO_CAPTURE` | Write a 30-second tail capture of 5-channel interleaved S16 audio (final L/R, DSPP L/R, FIFO-empty flag) when the audio device stops. |
| `M2_AUDIO_CBD2_DIAG` | Trace bounded host CBD2 stream starts, links, and attachment completions with stream/attachment IDs and decoded frame counts. |
| `M2_AUDIO_CBD2_DIAG_N` | Raise the CBD2 event cap above its default of 128 (ceiling 4096). |
| `M2_AUDIO_CLOCK_DIAG` | Trace the bounded rendered-frame/audio-time values at the audio timer pump and GetAudioTime/GetAudioFrameCount boundaries (64 records per source). |
| `M2_AUDIO_DSPP_DIAG_N` | Raise the audio DSPP diagnostic cap above its default of 32 (ceiling 4096). |
| `M2_AUDIO_LOCK_DIAG` | Print an [audio-lock] contention summary at exit with acquisition counts, wait times, top holder sites, and top waiter sites. |
| `M2_AUDIO_MIX_DIAG` | Log resident-mix voice-fed values per tick ([audio-mix], capped). |
| `M2_AUDIO_SAMPLE_DIAG` | Trace CreateSample (.imsasound) item creation (cap 32) and SetAudioItemInfo TagArg lists (cap 64). |
| `M2_AUDIO_START_DIAG` | Trace StartInstrument, File Folio/AIFF loads, and StartAttachment results including template names, sample counts, and active voices (cap 64). |
| `M2_AUDIO_START_DIAG_N` | Raise the audio-start diagnostic cap above its default of 64 (ceiling 4096). |
| `M2_AUDIO_TRIGGER` | Trace folio-6 (audio) selector calls before dispatch with caller PC and registers (capped). |
| `M2_AUDIO_VOICE_DIAG` | Trace sampler playback-rate and gain transitions during race audio playback (cap 2048). |
| `M2_AUDIO_VOICE_TRACE` | Trace a specific guest audio voice slot (by slot index), logging instrument and host voice state when it goes silent (cap 24). |
| `M2_DISABLE_MIXER` | Skip opening the SDL audio stream while keeping windowed rendering and frame pacing. |
| `M2_DSPP_CAPTURE` | Dump pushed DSPP S16LE stereo frames to path (10 s cap). |
| `M2_DSPP_EXEC_TRACE` | Bounded pc/command trace of DSPP simulator execution. |
| `M2_FORCE_MIXER` | In headless mode, open the SDL audio mixer using a dummy audio driver instead of disabling the mixer. |
| `M2_KNOBTYPE_DIAG` | Log typed audio knob writes (instrument, knob, part, type, value, converted raw value; 64 lines) to check the SetKnobPart type conversion. |

## Graphics (CLT) diagnostics

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `M2_ACCEPT_MAX` | CLT bridge: raise the [clt-accept] textured-draw audit cap above the default 32 (max 512) to reach late-frame showroom draws; requires M2_DRAW_DIAG + M2_DRAW_DIAG_FROM. |
| `M2_CEL_DUMP_DIR` | Directory for M2_CEL_DUMP_SIZE output (default build/scratch/cel_dump). |
| `M2_CEL_DUMP_SIZE` | Soft backend: comma-separated WxH list; each distinct matching raster is written once as a PPM named with its 32-bit diagnostic hash and 64-bit FNV RGBA replacement hash. |
| `M2_CLEAN_SELFTEST` | Run the clean-renderer self-test instead of the normal frame loop. |
| `M2_CLEAN_SELFTEST_DIR` | Output directory for the clean-renderer self-test artifacts. |
| `M2_CLT_BRIDGE_TRACE` | Trace live CLT interpretation inside the GuestCltBridge (per-list verdicts, [clt-tex-fail] texture rejects). |
| `M2_CLT_CARVE_DUMP` | When presenting a display carve, compare the selected target against its previous frame and sibling buffer ([carve-dump], capped). |
| `M2_CLT_CARVE_DUMP_DIR` | With M2_CLT_CARVE_DUMP, also write each sampled carve to this directory as a PPM. |
| `M2_CLT_CARVE_DUMP_FROM` | Begin M2_CLT_CARVE_DUMP at this host frame. |
| `M2_CLT_CARVE_DUMP_IMAGES_MAX` | Cap PPM images written by M2_CLT_CARVE_DUMP_DIR (default 64). |
| `M2_CLT_COLOR_PERSPECTIVE` | Soft-capture probe: interpolate vertex colors with perspective division instead of screen-space affine interpolation. |
| `M2_CLT_DEPTH_CLEAR` | Soft-capture depth clear value in [0, 1]; defaults to 0 for guest reciprocal-W ordering and 1 for reversed/W16 probes. |
| `M2_CLT_DEPTH_MAME` | Soft-capture probe using MAME's float-W depth comparison mask polarity. |
| `M2_CLT_DEPTH_RAW` | Soft-capture depth mode: unset or 1 uses guest reciprocal-W ordering (clear 0); 0 uses reversed float depth (clear 1). |
| `M2_CLT_DEPTH_W16` | Soft-capture probe using four-range 16-bit W quantization with reversed host Z. |
| `M2_CLT_DEPTH_W16_MAME` | Soft-capture probe using MAME's 16-bit W depth comparison mask polarity. |
| `M2_CLT_DEPTH_W16_PACKED` | Soft-capture probe using range bits 15:14 plus a 14-bit W significand. |
| `M2_CLT_DEPTH_W16_RAW` | Soft-capture probe using four-range 16-bit W quantization with direct guest 1/w ordering. |
| `M2_CLT_DEST_GIANT_ONLY` | Restrict M2_CLT_DEST_TRACE to the bounded giant-triangle classification path. |
| `M2_CLT_DEST_LIST_FROM` | Begin M2_CLT_DEST_TRACE at this executed CLT-list sequence number. |
| `M2_CLT_DEST_LIST_TO` | Stop M2_CLT_DEST_TRACE after this executed CLT-list sequence number. |
| `M2_CLT_DEST_MAX` | Cap entries emitted by M2_CLT_DEST_TRACE (default 128, maximum 512). |
| `M2_CLT_DEST_TRACE` | Trace bounded large-triangle destination/Z state, including DBUSERCONTROL, DBDISCARDCONTROL, DBZCNTL, destination mask, and 1/w range. |
| `M2_CLT_DRAW_CURSOR` | Trace bounded State 2 CLT word offsets and material/draw state for NEW and retained continuation geometry. |
| `M2_CLT_DRAW_CURSOR_MAX` | Cap retained-continuation entries emitted by M2_CLT_DRAW_CURSOR (default 4096, maximum 20000). |
| `M2_CLT_DRAW_LIST` | CLT bridge: restrict [clt-cursor] draw tracing and texture audits ([publish]/[mat-dims]/[clt-accept]) to a single executed list sequence number. |
| `M2_CLT_FACING_CENSUS` | Soft backend: log one [facing] line per opaque textured draw with triangle count, screen-space winding counts, depth/blend flags, texture dimensions, and bounding box. |
| `M2_CLT_FACING_FRAME` | Soft backend: start M2_CLT_FACING_CENSUS at this host frame. |
| `M2_CLT_FRAME_TRACE` | Correlate host presentation frames with executed CLT list sequence, emitted triangles, broad substantial-triangle count, and clear/present boundaries. |
| `M2_CLT_INFLIGHT_OVERLAY` | Default-on in-flight CLT look-ahead scope: restricts in-flight list pumping to the FMV video-overlay path; =0 runs look-ahead pumping across all scenes. |
| `M2_CLT_LIST_DUMP` | CLT bridge: dump the raw 32-bit word stream of the list selected by M2_CLT_DRAW_LIST to this file path. |
| `M2_CLT_LOD_FIXED` | Soft-capture probe: force a fixed texture mip LOD level across all samples instead of per-triangle screen-space gradients. |
| `M2_CLT_PERSIST_TARGET` | Default-on color-target persistence across host frames; =0 clears color and depth at the start of every host frame. |
| `M2_CLT_ROOM_MMDMA_DIAG` | Trace bounded showroom MMDMA/PIP texture classification and materialization details. |
| `M2_CLT_SELECT_DUMP` | Sample destination and armed DB-source contents on their first selection in each guest frame before drawing. |
| `M2_CLT_SELECT_DUMP_FROM` | Begin M2_CLT_SELECT_DUMP at this host frame. |
| `M2_CLT_SRCALPHA16_TRIPWIRE` | Tripwire for 16-bpp source-alpha blending: =1 exits with code 86 on the first rgb-refused draw and logs distinct written-alpha signatures ([clt-srcalpha16]); =log logs without exiting; =all exits on both. |
| `M2_CLT_SUPER_TRACE` | Trace bounded guest writes to DBSUPERGENCONTROL (0x8004). |
| `M2_CLT_SUPER_TRACE_MAX` | Cap entries emitted by M2_CLT_SUPER_TRACE (default 128, maximum 512). |
| `M2_CLT_TRANSACTION_TRACE` | Log [xact-frame] per presenter iteration, [xact-clt] per executed command list, and [xact-display] per DISPLAYFRAMEBUFFER publication (capped at 4000 lines per stream). |
| `M2_CLT_TRANSACTION_TRACE_FROM` | Begin M2_CLT_TRANSACTION_TRACE at this host frame. |
| `M2_CLT_UNSUPPORTED_DIAG` | Attribute each CLT unsupported increment to its site + key ([clt-reject] shape, per-site capped). |
| `M2_CLT_UNSUPPORTED_DIAG_MAX` | Cap for unsupported-attribution lines (default 64, ceiling 1024). |
| `M2_CLT_Z_CELL_DUMP` | Dump the first K raw 16-bit guest Z-buffer cells at z_base + 2*(x+y*stride) on the first executed list at or after M2_CLT_Z_SURFACE_TRACE_FROM (default K=16, max 256). |
| `M2_CLT_Z_CENSUS` | Log distinct destination/Z register and blend states observed across emitted guest triangles. |
| `M2_CLT_Z_CENSUS_LIST_FROM` | Begin M2_CLT_Z_CENSUS at this executed CLT-list sequence number. |
| `M2_CLT_Z_CENSUS_MAX` | Cap distinct states emitted by M2_CLT_Z_CENSUS (default 64, maximum 128). |
| `M2_CLT_Z_SURFACE_TRACE` | Trace bounded guest writes to destination, Z, and SSB/DSB surface registers used by the CLT interpreter. |
| `M2_CLT_Z_SURFACE_TRACE_FROM` | Begin M2_CLT_Z_SURFACE_TRACE at this executed CLT-list sequence number; earlier lists emit nothing and do not consume the cap. |
| `M2_CLT_Z_SURFACE_TRACE_MAX` | Cap entries emitted by M2_CLT_Z_SURFACE_TRACE (default 256, maximum 1024). |
| `M2_CONFIG_TEXTURE_TRACE` | Trace source, decode, and TRAM hashes for the 508x29 Configure Car footer texture (source 0x6eb468, byte count 0x398c). |
| `M2_CONFIG_TEXTURE_TRACE_MAX` | Cap entries emitted per stage by M2_CONFIG_TEXTURE_TRACE (default 256, maximum 1024). |
| `M2_DBSRC_CLASSIFY_TRACE` | Log the origin decision for every DB-source materialization: armed base, signed offset, resolved origin, each candidate span's window and vertex-sample tests, and the outcome (bounded). |
| `M2_DBSRC_DIAG` | CLT bridge: trace DB-source blit arming (base/stride/snapshot availability, sampled source rows) from a guest-frame floor (M2_DRAW_DIAG_FROM), capped. |
| `M2_DBSRC_FB_READBACK` | Serve DB-source blits from retained presented frames instead of guest RAM (menu background remedy). |
| `M2_DBSRC_INPROGRESS` | Display-carve DB-source blits read the addressed in-progress guest color target by default (software and GL race windshield path); set =0 to read guest RAM instead for A/B comparison, or combine =0 with M2_DBSRC_FB_READBACK=1 for retained-frame readback. |
| `M2_DBSRC_SKIP` | Drop DB-source background draws instead of rasterizing them (opt-in; shows whether those draws cover the scene). |
| `M2_DISABLE_SCISSOR` | Disable the backend scissor test when set in the environment. |
| `M2_DRAW_DIAG` | Log up to 64 vertex-reject reasons, per-submit list verdicts, and texture publication audits ([publish] and [clt-accept]) starting from M2_DRAW_DIAG_FROM. |
| `M2_DRAW_DIAG_FROM` | CLT/TE diagnostics: guest-frame floor for M2_DRAW_DIAG_* diagnostics (GuestFramesStarted counter). |
| `M2_DRAW_MAX_SEQ` | Only capture draws up to this draw-sequence number (default all). |
| `M2_DRAW_ORDER_FRAME` | Soft backend: log every clt_draw bbox/mode for one host frame (painter's-order dump), capped. |
| `M2_DRAW_PROV_FRAME` | CLT bridge: log one [draw-prov] line per emitted draw (exec seq, header, destination base/stride, DB source/Z base, bbox, ow range, ztest/zwrite, PIP/expansion/LOD0 state, serve dims) for exactly one host frame, capped. |
| `M2_DRAW_PROV_SERVE` | CLT bridge: log [draw-prov] lines for every draw using a texture of the given WxH dimensions. |
| `M2_DRAW_SKIP_RANGE` | Skip captured draws in the N-M sequence window. |
| `M2_FORCE_TRANSITION` | Force the random screen-transition effect to a specific mode: rotate, rotate-reverse, scroll, scroll2..scroll4, wipe, wipe2..wipe4, stripes, grid, square1, square2, or dotrans type 0..16. |
| `M2_GFX_IO_TRACE` | Trace bounded guest TE setup/submit IO, including GS_ClearFBZ options and framebuffer/Z clear payload words. EXECUTELIST entries also carry the active framebuffer/Z items resolved to bitmap buffers/types. |
| `M2_GFX_IO_TRACE_FROM` | Begin M2_GFX_IO_TRACE at this guest frame (entries below the floor are suppressed without consuming the entry cap; unset traces all frames). |
| `M2_GFX_IO_TRACE_MAX` | Cap entries emitted by M2_GFX_IO_TRACE (default 128, maximum 512). |
| `M2_GL_BACKEND` | Select the OpenGL backend variant: cel for the fallback cel backend, null for a no-op backend (isolating CLT decode cost from GL submission), or unset for the default clean renderer. |
| `M2_LIGHT_HOST_WRITE_TRACE` | Log host-side writes to the light-function dispatch tables. |
| `M2_LIGHT_MEMORY_TRACE` | Log guest memory operations that touch the light-function dispatch tables (0x93ab00..0x93ab40). |
| `M2_LIGHT_READ_TRACE` | Log guest reads of the light-function dispatch tables. |
| `M2_LIGHT_RETURN_TRACE` | Log the first 64 M_Light* return-handler reads. |
| `M2_LIGHT_WRITE_TRACE` | Log guest writes to the light-function dispatch tables. |
| `M2_LIVERY_DRAW_DIAG` | Trace 192x112 livery and State 3 nose cels (647x51, 988x79, 198x52) with texture, tint, vertex, depth, and bounding-box details, including depth-test winners when occluded. |
| `M2_LIVERY_DRAW_DIAG_FRAME` | Begin detailed M2_LIVERY_DRAW_DIAG logging at this host frame. |
| `M2_LIVERY_DRAW_DIAG_MAX` | Cap entries emitted by M2_LIVERY_DRAW_DIAG (default 32, maximum 512). |
| `M2_LIVERY_LIST_DIAG` | Trace bounded CLT list/material markers used to correlate showroom livery continuations. |
| `M2_LIVERY_LIST_DIAG_MAX` | Cap entries emitted by M2_LIVERY_LIST_DIAG (default 64, maximum 512). |
| `M2_LIVERY_PRODUCER_DIAG` | Trace bounded guest-side livery list publication provenance. |
| `M2_LIVERY_PRODUCER_DIAG_FROM` | Begin M2_LIVERY_PRODUCER_DIAG at this guest frame. |
| `M2_LIVERY_PRODUCER_DIAG_MAX` | Cap entries emitted by M2_LIVERY_PRODUCER_DIAG (default 96). |
| `M2_TEXDUMP_MAX` | CLT bridge: raise the texdump decoded-texture PPM cap above the default 16 (max 256) to reach late-frame showroom textures; requires M2_DRAW_DIAG + M2_DRAW_DIAG_FROM. |
| `M2_WINCLIP_TRACE` | Trace window-clip register writes (capped at 50). |

## Triangle Engine emulation

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `M2_TECENSIS` | TE emulation: after the first EXECUTELIST >= 15000 bytes, trace the next SendIO commands verbatim (arm marker + per-command lines, capped) so the per-frame submit pattern and any payload-less len=0 EXECUTELISTs become visible. |
| `M2_TE_POLL_COUNT` | TE emulation: max TE poll responses per frame (drive-stall tuning). |
| `M2_TE_PUBLICATION_TRACE_FROM` | TE ring diagnostic: first guest frame for 64 pre-filter publications; requires M2_TE_RING_SUBMIT=1; logs cap expiry. |
| `M2_TE_RING_AUDIT` | Correlate accepted Reserve-mode producer publications with bridge consumer lists using sequence, address, length, and FNV checksum. |
| `M2_TE_RING_AUDIT_FROM` | Begin M2_TE_RING_AUDIT at this guest/host frame floor while retaining comparable sequence numbers. |
| `M2_TE_RING_AUDIT_MAX` | Cap producer and consumer entries emitted by M2_TE_RING_AUDIT (default 128, maximum 512). |
| `M2_TE_RING_SUBMIT` | Default-on TE emulation: parse authentic Reserve-mode ring CLT at SetTEWritePointer and submit it as EXECUTELIST; =0 only tracks the write pointer without submitting the ring, while explicit =1 also logs capped [te-ring] resolutions. |
| `M2_TE_SUBMIT_COUNT` | TE emulation: max TE submit responses per frame (drive-stall tuning). |
| `M2_TE_SUBMIT_TRACE` | TE emulation: trace TE submit/te_read-te_write byte-counter advances. |
| `M2_TE_SUBMIT_TRACE_FROM` | TE emulation: first guest frame for M2_TE_SUBMIT_TRACE output. |
| `M2_TE_VERTEX_STATE_FLAT` | TE diagnostic: draw guest-derived retained-state triangles with deterministic flat colors, bypassing material, texture, depth, and color interpretation. |
| `M2_TE_VERTEX_STATE_FLAT_DEPTH` | TE diagnostic: with flat mode enabled, preserve the guest DB depth test/write state instead of forcing painter-order rendering. |
| `M2_TE_VERTEX_STATE_FLAT_TRACE` | TE diagnostic: trace flat retained-state triangle source list/header and viewport-adjusted bbox; capped by M2_TE_VERTEX_STATE_MAX. |
| `M2_TE_VERTEX_STATE_HEADER` | TE diagnostic: restrict retained-state trace entries to one CLT header value. |
| `M2_TE_VERTEX_STATE_LIST_FROM` | TE diagnostic: begin retained-state and flat-triangle source tracing at this executed CLT-list sequence number. |
| `M2_TE_VERTEX_STATE_MAX` | TE diagnostic: cap for retained-state and flat-triangle trace entries (default 256, maximum 4096). |
| `M2_TE_VERTEX_STATE_TRACE` | TE diagnostic: trace retained vertex count, replacement sort, vertex IDs, and emitted triangle geometry. |

## Capture, screenshots & preview driver

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `M2_CAPTURE_FROM` | Headless capture: first host frame to write as PPM (frames below the floor are presented but not written; default 0 = write all). |
| `M2_CAPTURE_SOURCE_DIAG` | Log [cap-source] and [cap-target] lines on the specified host frames ("all", "N", or comma-separated ranges) showing which scanout bitmap or CLT color target served each presented frame. |
| `M2_PREVIEW_MODE` | Preview driver in m2host: "hold" waits for state 2/25; "advance" runs the state-relative race navigation script (menu -> car -> track -> State 3); safe under --fast-forward. |
| `M2_PREVIEW_TRACK_PULSES` | Number of D-pad Right pulses (0-8) on the track-select screen when using M2_PREVIEW_MODE=advance (0 = Testona, 1 = Laguna Seca, 2 = New Orleans, 3 = Suzuka, 4 = Skid Pad). |
| `M2_SCREENSHOT_KEY` | m2host windowed runs: F12 saves the presented frame as a PNG at the internal render size (M2_RENDER_SCALE applies) into M2_SCREENSHOT_ROOT or the default screenshots folder. Host-only; the guest never sees the key. |
| `M2_SHOT_DIR` | m2host interactive shot sink: write PPM snapshots of presented frames to this directory. |
| `M2_SHOT_FRAMES` | m2host shot sink: comma-separated 0-based host frame numbers to snap (needs M2_SHOT_DIR). |

## Input & car simulation

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `M2_CARSIM_HOLD_TRACK_INIT` | Default-on guest track-init worker lifetime: wait for the authentic teardown signal instead of injecting it; =0 injects the signal instead. |
| `M2_CARSIM_MPIO_BRIDGE` | Default-on execution of the original guest function in the recovered MPIO packet; =0 completes the packet without running the function. |
| `M2_CARSIM_MPIO_DIAG` | Log bounded car-sim MPIO request diagnostics. |
| `M2_CARSIM_SIGNAL_DIAG` | Log bounded car-sim signal delivery diagnostics. |
| `M2_CARSIM_TIMER_BRIDGE` | Default-on recurring owner-scoped TIMERCMD_METRONOME_USEC service; =0 completes each timer request immediately, for diagnostic comparison. |
| `M2_PLAYER_AI` | Debug-only player-car autopilot for unattended testing; =1 selects the original complexSim AI controller path for the player car. It does not complete every track, so the launcher does not offer it; set it in the environment instead. |
| `M2_SECRET_CPORT_WORD_AXES` | ControlPort bridge layout override; the recovered 32-bit StickEventData word layout is default, while 0 selects a packed-byte layout for comparison. |
| `M2_SECRET_INPUT_PROBE` | Drive probe: trace the guest input pipeline (poll -> cport -> guest maps). |
| `M2_STATE2_INPUT_PROV` | =1 traces input provenance during primary state 2. |
| `M2_TAIL_BUTTONS` | Drive probe: buttons held after the script finishes (tail input). |
| `M2_TAIL_STICK_X` | Drive probe: stick X held after the script finishes (tail input). |
| `M2_TAIL_STICK_Y` | Drive probe: stick Y held after the script finishes (tail input). |
